name: explore-os-shell
description: Electron shell for explore-os — boots a PyInstaller-bundled Django sidecar (Waitress) and a BrowserWindow.
author: explore-os

scripts.build:sidecar: cd .. && uv run pyinstaller build/sidecar-cuda.spec --noconfirm --distpath dist
scripts.build:all: npm run build:sidecar && npm run build:electron
